# postgresql_replication_slot (Resource)

The `postgresql_replication_slot` resource creates and manages a replication slot on a PostgreSQL server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "postgresql_replication_slot" "my_slot" {
  name   = "my_slot"
  plugin = "test_decoding"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the replication slot.
- `plugin` (String) Sets the output plugin.

### Optional

- `database` (String) Which database to create the replication slot on. Defaults to provider database.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import postgresql_replication_slot.my_slot my_database.my_slot
```
